claim: A first learned typed-trace surface planner passed seven permissioned real-local shadow groups and seven hostile human-prose decoys without gaining rendering or training authority.
claimBoundary: Seven local source groups are operational shadow evidence only. They do not prove general language, independent transfer, calibration, neutrality, wisdom, safety, or readiness for active rendering.

source.discovery: verified reasoning experience receipts filtered by REAL_LOCAL_LESSON, with missing legacy experienceKind interpreted by the existing v3 compatibility rule

knownLimits: No independently authored external held-out trace has been evaluated.
All real traces came from one local research environment.
The learned organ selects only seven coarse surface plans and does not generate free prose.
Model-relative scores are not calibrated truth probabilities.
A clean seven-group result does not establish distribution-shift robustness.
The active runtime and Learning Shell do not load this learned organ.
nextGate: Independent permissioned typed traces plus frozen distribution-shift cases must pass without threshold reduction; any mismatch stays review-only and cannot self-train.
